description.7.0: Show information about structural element nodes in the range.
description.9.0: List properties and responses of structural element nodes in the range.

keywords.name: acceleration
keywords.description: List translational and rotational acceleration at each node (node-local frame). Options: global: values are expressed in the global system; local: values are expressed in the node-local system. This is the default if no keyword is specified.

description.7.0: list values of applied conditions on the node. One of the following keywords can be supplied to specify which apply condition is listed. Options: force: applied force on the node in the local system. This is the default if no keyword is specified.; moment: applied moments on the node in the local system
description.9.0: List the applied force/moment condition (if any) on each node.

keywords.name: apply-force
keywords.description: applied force on the node in the local system. This is the default if no keyword is specified.

keywords.name: apply-moment
keywords.description: applied moments on the node in the local system

description.7.0: lists the component-id numbers of all elements that are connected to this node
description.9.0: List which structural elements each node is connected to.

description.7.0: list both the translation and rotational (angular) displacements of the node. The following keywords, if present, allow the selection of the coordinate system these are displayed in: Options: global: displays values in the global coordinate system; local: displays values in the local coordinate system; this is the default if not specified
description.9.0: List translational and rotational displacement at each node (node-local frame). Options: global: values are expressed in the global system; local: values are expressed in the node-local system. This is the default if no keyword is specified.

keywords.name: displacement-global
keywords.description: displays values in the global coordinate system

keywords.name: displacement-local
keywords.description: displays values in the local coordinate system; this is the default if not specified

description.7.0: velocity fixity in terms of nodal local coordinate system
description.9.0: List velocity-fixity conditions (free/fixed/slaved) per DOF for each node.

description.7.0: fixity state of node-local coordinate system
description.9.0: List whether the node-local coordinate system is fixed (will not be updated automatically by SELs).

description.7.0: unbalanced force and moment is displayed in terms of the nodal local coordinate system
description.9.0: List the out-of-balance force and moment at each node (node-local frame). Options: global: values are expressed in the global system; local: values are expressed in the node-local system. This is the default if no keyword is specified.

description.7.0: lists the component-id numbers of any links that are attached to the node
description.9.0: List the structural links attached to each node.

description.7.0: translational and rotational (angular) components are displayed in terms of the nodal local coordinate system
description.9.0: List translational and rotational mass at each node.

description.7.0: position of the nodes in the range. There are two different position values possible; the following keywords (if present) allow you to select which position is displayed. By default, the reference position is used. Options: current: the current position of the node, which is updated from the starting (or reference) position even in small strain mode; reference: the reference position of the node, which is updated only in large-strain mode. In small-strain mode, this is the starting location of the node and does not change.
description.9.0: List node positions (reference configuration, global frame), plus hidden/selected flags. Options: current: current position of the node, which is updated from the starting (or reference) position even in small-strain mode; reference: reference position of the node, which is updated only in large-strain mode. In small-strain mode, this is the initial location of the node and does not change. The reference position corresponds to the nodal position at the time that the stiffness matrices of all finite elements that use the node were formed.

keywords.name: ratio-target
keywords.description: List the target convergence ratio applied at each node (if any).

keywords.name: position-current
keywords.description: the current position of the node, which is updated from the starting (or reference) position even in small strain mode

keywords.name: position-reference
keywords.description: the reference position of the node, which is updated only in large-strain mode. In small-strain mode, this is the starting location of the node and does not change.

description.7.0: translational and rotational (angular) components are displayed in terms of the nodal local coordinate system
description.9.0: List translational and rotational stiffness at each node.

description.7.0: the directions of the local coordinate system used by the nodes are displayed
description.9.0: List the node-local coordinate system (x/y/z basis vectors) for each node.
List the surface coordinate system used at each node. (3D only.)

description.7.0: translational and rotational (angular) velocities are in terms of the global or nodal local (default) coordinate systems. The following keywords, if present, allow the selection of the coordinate system these are displayed in:
description.9.0: List translational and rotational velocity at each node (node-local frame). Options: global: values are expressed in the global system; local: values are expressed in the node-local system. This is the default if no keyword is specified.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: List group memberships of each node (optionally restricted to slot s).

keywords.name: velocity-global
keywords.description: displays values in the global coordinate system

keywords.name: velocity-local
keywords.description: displays values in the local coordinate system; this is the default if not specified

keywords.name: damping
keywords.description: List the damping type and properties applied at each node.
